io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.//: Profile costs are published here so a host can size the surface before installing. They are asserted against the server's own profile table by crates/memnoth-mcp/src/lib.rs::tests::registry_manifest_profile_counts_match_the_table, so this metadata cannot drift from the code.

retrievalTierCost.//: The retrieval half of the context tax: what one query costs at each recall tier, beside the tools/list half above. Values come from crates/memnoth-mcp/src/recall_budget.rs::tier_cost_rows and cannot drift (registry_manifest_retrieval_cost_cannot_drift).

toolSchemaCost.//: Bytes of the tools/list payload each profile makes a host pay - the context tax, published instead of asserted. Every rival in this category publishes this number (1.9K / ~7K / 11.6K / 170 tokens); memnoth published none. Filled in by `cargo test -p memnoth-mcp -- --ignored regenerate_manifest_schema_cost` after a build, and a test fails if these ever drift from the shipping definitions.

writeApproval.//: Bulk or identity-changing writes (mem_ingest, mem_merge, mem_supersede, mem_forget) are confirmed before they run, using multi-round-trip elicitation (SEP-2322). Elicitation is a core client capability, NOT an extension id, so it is named here rather than in `extensions`. Hosts that do not declare it are never asked and keep the old synchronous behaviour. Set MEMNOTH_MCP_WRITE_APPROVAL=off to answer without asking.

description: Memory, coordination and code intelligence for coding agents. A bi-temporal knowledge-graph vault (history, as-of queries, contradiction detection), a code graph that answers a flow question with verbatim line-numbered source in one call, and first-writer-wins path claims so parallel agents stop colliding.
name: ai.astrivya.memnoth

environmentVariables.description: Path to the memnoth binary when it is not on PATH. The npm package bundles the binary under vendor/<platform>-<arch>/; set this to override the bundled copy.
environmentVariables.name: MEMNOTH_BIN

environmentVariables.description: Tool surface to expose: micro (4 tools), memory (21), code (26), coord (11), full (51), agent (6, HTTP only). Default: full.
environmentVariables.name: MEMNOTH_MCP_PROFILE
